events.title: RabbitMQ launched
events.summary: LShift and CohesiveFT launched RabbitMQ on February 8, 2007 — an open-source AMQP message broker for reliable enterprise messaging.
events.about: RabbitMQ routes messages between producers and consumers through exchanges and queues — decoupling microservices, job workers, and event pipelines. It implements AMQP with clustering, persistence, and language clients for Java, Python, and Node. Example: a web app publishes `order.created` events; fulfillment and email services consume them asynchronously.

narrative.whyChosen: RabbitMQ was the first production-grade open-source AMQP broker.
narrative.whyImportant: It made message queues mainstream before Kafka and cloud pub/sub services.
narrative.problemSolved: Applications coupled via direct HTTP calls could not absorb traffic spikes or retry failed work reliably.
